scenes.spoken_text: Appliance integration requires more than fitting the visible body. Coordinate the exact model with its installation envelope, airflow, services and access.
scenes.caption: Appliance integration requires more than fitting the visible body. Coordinate the exact model with its installation envelope, airflow, services and access.

scenes.spoken_text: Record manufacturer, full model, market, installed configuration, manual identifier/revision and requirement page. A marketing width such as “60 cm” is not an installation opening. Collect device envelope, cavity and neighboring-device compatibility. Assign missing information an owner rather than guessing dimensions.
scenes.caption: Tie each requirement to an exact model and page.

scenes.spoken_text: Review the required cavity and airflow path in the exact appliance manual. As a manual-reading example, Bosch CPA565GS0B section 21.3 addresses cabinet backs and ventilation as well as space. Map requirements onto a cabinet section without transferring them to another model. A nominal void does not meet a required path if furniture blocks it.
scenes.caption: This is a model-specific manual-reading exercise.

scenes.spoken_text: Show service/access zones and removal routes from the manual. The service specialist reviews services while furniture design coordinates parts around them. A model substitution reopens cavity, airflow, services, movement and support; approval of the original does not transfer automatically.
scenes.caption: A model substitution reopens affected interfaces.

scenes.spoken_text: A replacement has the same marketed size but different installation documentation. Update its record and review cavity, back, airflow and services before releasing procurement or manufacture. Decision: review the replacement requirements before approval.
scenes.caption: Decision: review the replacement requirements before approval.

scenes.display_title: Submit two referenced appliance records, a cavity/service section and a substitution review.
scenes.spoken_text: Submit two referenced appliance records, a cavity/service section and a substitution review.
scenes.caption: Submit two referenced appliance records, a cavity/service section and a substitution review.
